description: Live bug: conflating a flagship series with its branded spin-offs by stripping the spin-off's distinguishing subtitle caused cross-series contamination -- books from an entirely separate spin-off series got pulled into the flagship series being checked. 'Starship's Mage: Red Falcon' and 'Starship's Mage: UnArcana Rebellion' are real, distinct sub-series/rebranded editions of Glynn Stewart's 'Starship's Mage', not a cataloguer's generic branding suffix, and must NOT normalize to the same key as the bare 'Starship's Mage' flagship name. Frozen from tests/test_series_discovery.py::DiscoveryEngineHelperTest::test_normalize_series_branding_name_does_not_strip_distinctive_qualifiers.
